name: Heavy Stance
description: Take the school's low stance with weight set in the legs so a push meets a standing wall.

name: Sinker Palm
description: Strike with a palm as heavy as lead in the school's first blow to the chest.

name: Muted Step
description: Pace forward in a measured heavy step that the ground takes without a sound.

name: Sagging Grip
description: Take hold of a foe and let its own weight sag it down into the grip.

name: Smothering Weight
description: Lay a smothering weight on a foe's chest so its qi cannot rise to answer.

name: Maul Palm
description: Hammer a palm down onto a guard with the whole stance behind it.

name: Weighted Ruin
description: Smash a weighted fist through a guard and the body beyond it in a single heavy blow.

name: Pressed Barrier
description: Press the air before the user into a barrier that blocks heavy blows and charges.

name: Mass Judgment
description: Bring the full weight of judgment on one foe so it is flattened and cannot rise.

name: Leaden Verdict
description: The school move that gives the heavy hand's verdict and leaves one foe crushed under its own weight.

name: Meteor Stance
description: Take the school's stance with qi gathered high so a heavy fall is ready to be called.

name: Streak Fist
description: Throw a fist that arrives like a falling streak and lands with the weight of a stone.

name: Falling Pace
description: Drop into a step that carries the user to the foe's side in a short heavy slide.

name: Landing Sense
description: Feel where a coming blow will land and how much weight it will bring to bear.

name: Cinder Drop
description: Call down a burning fragment of weight onto a distant foe in a short plunge.

name: Brake Load
description: Brake the speed of every foe in a small field by loading their steps.

name: Star Guard
description: Gather a shield of heavy light that crushes small missiles against its surface.

name: Plunge Wave
description: Land from a height and drive a wave of weight out across the floor in a ring.

name: Great Meteor
description: Hurl a vast weight down upon a single area so that it strikes like a meteor.

name: Orbit Cage
description: Throw weights in a cage about a foe so that every way out is closed to it.

name: Heavens Fall
description: Bring the heavens' weight down on a wide field so foes are struck and pinned.

name: Fallen Star
description: The school move that calls down a star's weight and leaves a crater of crushed ground.

name: Core Stance
description: Take a stance with weight drawn into the core and held there by the school's breathing.

name: Packed Palm
description: Strike a palm packed with drawn weight from the core into the foe's centre.

name: Inward Step
description: Step with the core's weight pulling the body forward into a close stance.

name: Drawn Weight
description: Draw weight from the surroundings into the core so the next strike is far heavier.

name: Dense Core
description: Pack the core so densely that blows to the body fall away like drops from stone.

name: Release Wave
description: Release a measured share of the stored weight from the core in a circular wave.

name: Core Hold
description: Pull a foe into the core's reach and hold it fast with the dense pull.

name: Pressure Burst
description: Burst the packed weight outward and flatten all that stand within the blast.

name: Singular Point
description: Compress the whole core's pull to a point and drive it through a guard in a line.

name: Hollowed Sphere
description: Take in the force around the user and send it back out as a crushing sphere.

name: Core Implosion
description: The school move that lets the stored core fall in on itself and break out as a crushing wave.

name: Carrier Stance
description: Take a bearing stance with a back bent to carry whatever weight falls on it.

name: Carried Blow
description: Return a taken blow with the weight it brought added to the user's own strike.

name: Hauler Step
description: Walk under a great weight in a steady plod that never falters or sways.

name: Stored Blow
description: Take a blow into the body's frame and store its weight in the bones.

name: Return Weight
description: Cast the stored weight back upon the foe that dealt it in a heavy shove.

name: Shared Load
description: Take a share of an ally's burden onto the user's own frame so the ally moves free.

name: Yoke Hold
description: Lay a heavy yoke across a foe's shoulders that bends its back and slows its feet.

name: Break the Back
description: Drop all stored burden on a foe's spine in one blow that folds it to the ground.

name: Bulwark of Burden
description: Raise a wall from the weight the user has borne that holds against any charge.

name: Burden Overturned
description: Cast back every load borne in the fight on all foes at once.

name: Burden Absolute
description: The school move that returns every burden borne at once and holds the foe beneath it.

name: Overcast Stance
description: Take the school's stance with the air thickened low around the shoulders.

name: Air Weight
description: Strike with a hand that lays the weight of a column of air on the target.

name: Low Glide
description: Skim low over the ground under the pressed air with no sway.

name: Pressed Roof
description: Press the air over the user into a roof that holds off falling blows.

name: Bird Drop
description: Drop a flier from the air by weighting every feather and wing.

name: Smothered Step
description: Press down on a foe's feet until it cannot take a step in any direction.

name: Descending Sky
description: Lower the pressed air onto an area so that all in it are driven down.

name: Thick Heaven
description: Thicken the air to a weight that bars any leap or flight across the area.

name: Ceiling Crash
description: Let the pressed ceiling fall in one crash upon everything standing beneath it.

name: Sky Pressed
description: The school move that presses the sky itself onto the field and holds all in it to the ground.

name: Reaching Stance
description: Take a stance with the arms open and the core ready to draw in what comes near.

name: Drawing Palm
description: Strike with an open palm that draws the foe onto the blow as it lands.

name: Pull Stride
description: Stride along a line of pull toward a fixed target at the full speed of a fall.

name: Distant Pull
description: Feel the lines of pull reaching out from the core and what each line has hold of.

name: Reaching Hold
description: Reach out across a distance with the pull and hold a foe at the end of it.

name: Gathered Arms
description: Draw an ally's thrown weapon or fallen limb back to them along a line of pull.

name: Reeling Blow
description: Reel a distant foe into the user's fist at the speed of a plunge.

name: Pull Dilation
description: Stretch the pull between two foes so that each tugs the other off its stance.

name: Drawing Pull
description: Open a field of pull across a wide space that draws all within it to the centre.

name: Pressing Core
description: Compress all drawn bodies at the centre until they are crushed against one another.

name: Everything Falls
description: Make all things in range fall toward the user and then crush what has gathered.

name: Limitless Pull
description: The school move that draws everything in the field to the user without limit and crushes it there.
